programme.title: Paranormal Contact
programme.desc: Jeff DeEll, Adam Myles, and Kelly Klassen explore haunted locations along Canada’s east coast, seeking contact with the dead and uncovering the hidden stories that linger in the shadows. Guided by intuition, research, and firsthand encounters, they venture deep into the unknown to give a voice to the spirits still waiting to be heard.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: New Jersey police working the murder of a woman bludgeoned to death in her own bed first think her boyfriend did it. When a desperate family member contacts renowned psychic Nancy Orlen Weber, Nancy sees the boyfriend is innocent, and gives police details that help undo the real killer's alibi. New Orleans investigators are stumped when a young mother turns up beaten to death, her son gravely injured. The suspects-the husband and his friend-blame each other, so investigators turn to psychic Rosemarie Kerr. Tapping into the fallen wife's vibration, Rosemarie discovers a truth more horrifying than anyone imagined.

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.desc: The team investigate Southport's Royal arcade. Located on Lord street Southport many ghostly tales originate from this building.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: Richard speaks with the pre-eminent investigators of the alleged crash of a UFO near Roswell, New Mexico in 1947. These researchers have investigated firsthand accounts, even death bed testimonials from many of the eye-witnesses to the incident, affirming the existence of such a craft, the ensuing government cover-up, and the recovery of alien bodies.

programme.title: Virginia Paranormal Case Files
programme.desc: The team at Virginia Paranormal Investigations travels the state investigating claims of paranormal activity and compiling the Virginia Paranormal Case Files. The show offers a balanced look at paranormal investigation. VAPI has a reputation for being honest and approaching each case with an open mind. The evidence is real, the people are real, and the reports are real.
